credits.title: Villeneuve: The Rise of a Champion
credits.overview: Showcases the early years of Québec racing driver Gilles Villeneuve.

credits.title: The Montenegro Affair
credits.overview: In 1951, a body is found at the Peel Bassin in Montreal. An enigmatic couple; Suzanne and Daniel; tries to get rid of two private detectives, Antonio Gratelli and Eduardo Ramirez; who suspect them of being guilty of the murder of a businessman, Maxime Montenegro.
